articles.title: Normal Working Hours
articles.text: The normal working hours of an employee shall not exceed eight (8) hours per day or forty-eight (48) hours per week.

articles.title: Rest Periods
articles.text: Every employee shall be entitled to a continuous rest period of not less than eight (8) hours between two consecutive working days.

articles.title: Weekly Rest
articles.text: Every employee shall be entitled to a continuous rest period of not less than twenty-four (24) hours in every seven-day period.

articles.title: Public Holidays
articles.text: Employees shall be entitled to public holidays as declared by law without deduction of pay.

articles.title: Annual Leave
articles.text: Every employee shall be entitled to annual leave with pay at the rate of one working day for each month of service.

articles.title: Sick Leave
articles.text: An employee who is unable to work due to sickness shall be entitled to sick leave with full pay for the first month and half pay for the second month.

articles.title: Maternity Leave
articles.text: A female employee shall be entitled to maternity leave of not less than ninety (90) consecutive days, of which at least forty-five (45) days shall be taken after confinement.

articles.title: Overtime Pay Rate
articles.text: An employee who works overtime on a normal working day shall be entitled to one and one-half (1.5) times the normal hourly rate of pay for each hour of overtime work.

articles.title: Rest Day and Holiday Overtime
articles.text: An employee required to work on a rest day or public holiday shall be entitled to twice (2.0x) the normal hourly rate of pay in addition to the normal daily wage.

articles.title: Maximum Overtime Hours
articles.text: Overtime work shall not exceed two (2) hours per day and ten (10) hours per week. Any overtime in excess of these limits requires written consent of the employee and approval from the Labour Inspection authority.

articles.title: Written Contract
articles.text: An employment contract may be made orally or in writing. However, a contract for a definite period of more than one month or for a specified piece of work shall be in writing.

articles.title: Termination by Employer
articles.text: An employer may terminate an employment contract without notice for a valid reason related to the employee's conduct or work performance, following a disciplinary hearing.

articles.title: Severance Pay
articles.text: An employee whose contract is terminated by the employer for reasons not related to the employee's fault shall be entitled to severance pay calculated at the rate of thirty (30) days wages per year of service.

articles.title: Grievance Procedure
articles.text: Any dispute arising from the interpretation or application of an employment contract or collective agreement shall first be submitted to the internal grievance committee before referral to a labour relations board.

articles.title: Prohibition of Forced Labour
articles.text: No person shall be required to perform forced or compulsory labour. Any violation of this provision is punishable under the applicable penal law.

articles.title: Non-Discrimination
articles.text: No employer shall discriminate against an employee on grounds of sex, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic origin, social status, marital status, or family responsibility.

articles.title: Equal Pay
articles.text: An employer shall pay equal remuneration to male and female employees for work of equal value.

articles.title: Occupational Safety
articles.text: Every employer is required to take all necessary measures to ensure the occupational safety and health of workers, including providing protective equipment and training.
